coverage.summary: Covers residential rental property in the City of San Diego. That means any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including units in a mobilehome park, under the § 98.0702 definition incorporated by § 98.1102. No unit-count, building-age, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits are stated.

result.notes: I removed the landlord-conduct and seller/licensor language from the summary. Coverage now describes only the covered property. Division 11 borrows only the definition of 'residential rental property' from § 98.0702. The § 98.0703 exemptions apply to 'this Division' (Division 7), not Division 11, so no unit, age or owner-occupancy exemptions carry over. The software exclusions in § 98.1102 describe the device, not the buildings, so they are not coverage fields. The ordinance appears only in draft form (blank ordinance number and passage date), so adoption is unconfirmed.
